newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes attacked suspected Hizbollah bases in south Lebanon on Monday, security sources said.
Two Israeli warplanes fired two rockets into the hills of Sojoud in the central sector of south Lebanon, they said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack which came shortly after Hizbollah guerrillas stormed into the Israeli outpost of Sojoud, planting their flags on the position.

Pro-Israeli militia sources gave no further details on the outpost attack. In Beirut, a Hizbollah spokesman said preliminary information indicated the guerrillas had killed Israeli soldiers during the attack.
Hizbollah guerrillas regularly attack Israeli troops trying to oust them from the south Lebanon occupation zone, which Israel says protects its northern border.
